settings.acceptedLanguagesHelp: An ordered preference list — first is most preferred. Used by the naming mode below to decide when to keep an original-language name.
settings.acceptedLanguagesEmpty: No languages added — original-language names are never preferred.
settings.namingModeDisplay: Use my display language for names, falling back to the original language if no translation exists
settings.namingModeOriginalIfAccepted: Use the original language if it's in my accepted list, otherwise fall back to my display language
settings.namingModeDual: Use my display language, and append the original-language name too when both exist and differ
